response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), 'Unknown') AS bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fielding f JOIN player p ON f.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), 'Unknown')), stats AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) * 1.0 AS total, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM counts) SELECT c.bats AS batting_hand, c.cnt AS fielding_count, c.cnt * 1.0 / s.total AS share, c.cnt - s.avg_cnt AS above_average FROM counts c CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE c.cnt > s.avg_cnt ORDER BY c.cnt DESC
